open_questions: The rows come from a child the probe starts with no inherited handles and an empty STARTUPINFO; that Steam starts the game the same way is the BLACKBOARD's assumption of 2026-10-10 (revisit with Steam in the local VM).
GetStartupInfoW leaves hStdInput, hStdOutput and hStdError unwritten when the start passed no handles: the probe's fill survives (row startup_info.child.values).
The title's length is the runner's path and is dropped from the rows; the title being the module path is kept.
